questions.label: PHQ-9 total score

calculate.calculateExpression: isNaN(parseInt(pleasure) + parseInt(depressed) + parseInt(tired)+ parseInt(sleep)+ parseInt(failure)+ parseInt(appetite)+ parseInt(concentrate)+ parseInt(speak)+ parseInt(dead)) ? undefined: (parseInt(pleasure) + parseInt(depressed) + parseInt(tired)+ parseInt(sleep)+ parseInt(failure)+ parseInt(appetite)+ parseInt(concentrate)+ parseInt(speak)+ parseInt(dead))

questions.label: PHQ-9 score rating

calculate.calculateExpression: parseInt(phqscore) >= 0 && parseInt(phqscore) <= 4 ? 'Depression unlikely' : parseInt(phqscore) >= 5 && parseInt(phqscore) <= 9 ? 'Mild depression': parseInt(phqscore) >= 10 && parseInt(phqscore) <= 14 ? 'Moderate depression': parseInt(phqscore) >= 15 && parseInt(phqscore) <= 19 ? 'Moderate severe depression' : parseInt(phqscore) >= 20 && parseInt(phqscore) <= 27 ? 'Severe depression' : 'Unknown'

questions.label: GAD total score

calculate.calculateExpression: isNaN(parseInt(nervous) + parseInt(worrying) + parseInt(differentthings)+ parseInt(troublerelaxing)+ parseInt(restless)+ parseInt(irritable)+ parseInt(afraid)) ? undefined: (parseInt(nervous) + parseInt(worrying) + parseInt(differentthings)+ parseInt(troublerelaxing)+ parseInt(restless)+ parseInt(irritable)+ parseInt(afraid))

questions.label: GAD score rating

calculate.calculateExpression: parseInt(score) >= 0 && parseInt(score) <= 4 ? 'Minimal anxiety' : parseInt(score) >= 5 && parseInt(score) <= 9 ? 'Mild anxiety': parseInt(score) >= 10 && parseInt(score) <= 14 ? 'Moderate anxiety': parseInt(score) >= 15 && parseInt(score) <= 21 ? 'Severe anxiety' : 'Unknown'
